name: Arteche Lantegi Elkartea, S.A.
summary: Arteche Lantegi Elkartea, S.A. specializes in the design, manufacturing, integration, and supply of electrical equipment and solutions, with a particular emphasis on renewable energy and smart grid technologies. The company serves clients both domestically in Spain and across international markets. Its extensive portfolio encompasses a broad range of products, including high and medium voltage instrument and power transformers (both conventional and digital), various sensors, and an array of specialized relays (such as railway, trip, supervision, and auxiliary). Additionally, Arteche provides sophisticated systems for grid management, including substation and distribution automation controllers, reclosers, switches, capacitor banks, harmonic trip solutions, and power quality devices. These offerings are crucial for measurement, protection, automation, monitoring, and communication functions across the entire electricity value chain – from generation to transmission and distribution. Established in 1946, Arteche Lantegi Elkartea, S.A. is headquartered in Mungia, Spain.
